headline: The AI Memory Boom Just Got a Reality Check—And a Better Entry Point
summary: The memory craze paused in July—and investors got a much-needed reality check.  American memory suppliers  Sandisk  and  Micron Technology  fell 47% and 29% for the period, respectively.  Sandisk notched its worst monthly performance since spinning off from  Western Digital  in February 2025, while Micron capped off its worst month since 2015.
